frame_observation.image: full backbuffer immediately before Present; no source or destination rectangle

visual_comparison: Bed silhouette, floor, doorway and viewpoint are recognizable in both images; no pixel-level alignment or complete geometric equivalence is claimed.
Texture, realistic lighting and shadows are absent in the DX12 reconstruction; the flat doorway background differs from the original.
The candle, distant target and character, HUD, and other draw passes are not reproduced.
limitations: The trace contains bounded application-lock shadow data and shader candidates, not verified GPU-consumed inputs.
The 35 selected draws are only one subset of the frame; unsupported states, render targets, occluders and depth history can change the result.
The original pixel shaders, textures, blending, lighting and postprocessing are not reproduced; colors are invented diagnostics.
D32_FLOAT and the D3D8-to-DX12 winding and pixel-center assumptions are not proved equivalent to the game's depth format or rasterizer.
Pre-Present readback is not proof of the final displayed pixels; concurrent Present operations are not fully observed.
This is a recognizable partial reconstruction, not a faithful legacy replay, pixel parity, native Windows validation or Scene IR runtime snapshot.
